import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Preprocessing function
def preprocess(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip('"').lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


train_df["clean"] = train_df["Comment"].fillna("").apply(preprocess)
test_df["clean"] = test_df["Comment"].fillna("").apply(preprocess)

# Stratified train/validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["clean"],
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Character-level TF-IDF vectorizer
vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), min_df=2, max_features=40000, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_tr_vec = vec.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_vec = vec.transform(X_val)

# Train model and compute validation score on hold-out set
clf = LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
clf.fit(X_tr_vec, y_tr)
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Train final model on full training data for submission
X_all_vec = vec.fit_transform(train_df["clean"])
final_clf = LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
final_clf.fit(X_all_vec, train_df["Insult"])

test_vec = vec.transform(test_df["clean"])
test_probs = final_clf.predict_proba(test_vec)[:, 1]

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Prediction": test_probs})
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
